segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct ContentView: View { enum Flavor: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable { var id: String { self.rawValue } case vanilla, chocolate, strawberry } var body: some View { List { ForEach(Flavor.allCases) { Text($0.rawValue) .listRowInsets(.leading, 25) } } } } ```
segments.contextBefore: The `listRowInsets(_:_:)` modifier then changes the leading inset of each row of the list and leaves the default insets on the other edges untouched:
